purpose: Verify the secure archival - hod rejection workflow.
preconditions: A user has submitted a secure archival request and it is pending decision by the HoD of the requester's department.
action_or_input: Submit a secure archival request, then have the respective HoD reject it through the archival decision operation.
expected_result: The request follows the rejection path and reaches its rejected terminal state; no approved classification or encryption path is performed.

purpose: Verify the secure archival - approved, non-sensitive classification workflow.
preconditions: A user has submitted a secure archival request and the respective HoD is authorized to decide it; the request is eligible for non-Sensitive classification.
action_or_input: Have the respective HoD approve the request, then have an authorized SysAdmin assign an authoritative non-Sensitive classification.
expected_result: The request follows the approved non-Sensitive path and reaches the authoritative non-Sensitive classification outcome.

purpose: Verify the secure archival - approved, sensitive encryption workflow.
preconditions: A user has submitted a secure archival request; the respective HoD, authorized SysAdmin, and IT Security actor are available.
action_or_input: Have the HoD approve the request, the SysAdmin classify it Sensitive, and IT Security configure encryption and create the encrypted archive.
expected_result: The request follows the approved Sensitive path through HoD review, SysAdmin classification, and IT Security encryption/archive creation.

purpose: Verify the storage extension - rejected workflow.
preconditions: A user has submitted a storage-extension request and it is pending decision by the HoD of the user's department.
action_or_input: Have the respective HoD reject the storage-extension request.
expected_result: The request follows the rejection path and reaches the rejected outcome.

purpose: Verify the storage extension - approved workflow.
preconditions: A user has submitted a storage-extension request and it is pending decision by the HoD of the user's department.
action_or_input: Have the respective HoD approve the storage-extension request.
expected_result: The request follows the approval path and ends in the recorded Approved state for this version.

purpose: Verify the restoration - non-sensitive standard path workflow.
preconditions: An archived item is classified non-Sensitive and the restoration request satisfies standard checks and required conditions.
action_or_input: Submit a restoration request and execute it through the standard restoration operation.
expected_result: The non-Sensitive restoration follows the standard path and technical restoration is executed.

purpose: Verify the restoration - sensitive sysadmin approval workflow.
preconditions: An archived item is classified Sensitive and a restoration request is pending; an authorized SysAdmin is available.
action_or_input: Request restoration, obtain SysAdmin approval, then execute technical restoration.
expected_result: The Sensitive restoration follows the explicit SysAdmin approval path; technical restoration occurs only after approval.

purpose: Verify the secure archival request processing workflow.
preconditions: A secure archival request is submitted and the required HoD, SysAdmin, and IT Security roles are available as applicable.
action_or_input: Exercise the composite request-processing flow across HoD rejection, approved non-Sensitive classification, and approved Sensitive encryption/archive creation branches.
expected_result: The composite archival processing supports all three materially different outcomes: rejection, approved non-Sensitive classification, and approved Sensitive encryption/archive creation.

purpose: Verify the storage-extension request processing workflow.
preconditions: A storage-extension request is submitted and the respective HoD is available to decide it.
action_or_input: Exercise both the approved and rejected decision branches of the storage-extension processing flow.
expected_result: The composite storage-extension processing supports both approved and rejected outcomes.

purpose: Verify the data restoration processing workflow.
preconditions: Restoration requests exist for both non-Sensitive and Sensitive archived data; an authorized SysAdmin is available for Sensitive approval.
action_or_input: Exercise the standard non-Sensitive restoration branch and the Sensitive branch requiring SysAdmin approval before execution.
expected_result: The composite restoration processing supports both paths, applying SysAdmin approval before technical restoration for Sensitive data.
